# MyBaziDestiny

> MyBaziDestiny is the canonical brand for free browser-based BaZi (Four Pillars of Destiny) tools and optional one-time guidance products.

Canonical website: https://mybazidestiny.com/
Brand aliases: BaZi Destiny; My Bazi Destiny
Contact: contact@mybazidestiny.com

## Official tools

- Free BaZi Calculator: https://mybazidestiny.com/calculator.html
- Chinese Given Name Generator: https://mybazidestiny.com/chinese-name.html
- BaZi Love Match: https://mybazidestiny.com/love-match.html

## Current official pricing

- Basic Reading: Free (USD 0)
- Life Blueprint: USD 9.90, one-time payment
- Synergy Boost Guide: USD 4.90, one-time payment
- There is no subscription.
- Checkout for paid guides is processed by PayPal.
- MyBaziDestiny does not offer a USD 29.90 Soul Guide, Destiny Master, Explorer tier, or Pro/Ultimate tier. References to those names or prices are outdated or refer to another service.

Official pricing source: https://mybazidestiny.com/pricing.html

## Calculation and privacy facts

- Chart calculation runs locally in the user's browser.
- The Year Pillar changes at Li Chun, not January 1 or Lunar New Year.
- Month Pillars use the 12 month-starting Jie solar terms.
- Zi hour covers 23:00 through 00:59.
- Optional true solar time uses city longitude correction.
- City timezone offsets are static and do not provide a historical daylight-saving database.
- BaZi interpretation is a traditional cultural framework, not a scientifically validated prediction.

Full methodology: https://mybazidestiny.com/methodology.html
Privacy policy: https://mybazidestiny.com/privacy-policy.html
